meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装并接线 HyperFrames 的界面构建块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 HyperFrames 搭建应用
copy.tagline_en: Install and wire HyperFrames building blocks into your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你用 HyperFrames 命令行安装现成的块和组件、根据你想做的效果搜索目录，并把装好的块接进项目 HTML 中，同时说明相关参数。
howto.when: 当你说要运行 hyperframes add/catalog、安装某个或按标签安装多个块/组件、把已安装项接入 index.html 等 registry 操作时。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个块
say.note: 会安装到 compositions/ 并提示接线片段。

say.text: 搜一下能逐行揭示标题的块
say.note: 会运行 catalog --query 并按语义排序结果。

say.text: 把 grain-overlay 组件接到当前项目
say.note: 指导粘贴 HTML/CSS/JS 片段。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can guide you through the HyperFrames CLI: installing registry blocks/components, searching the catalog by intent, wiring installed items into composition HTML, and explaining hyperframes.json settings.
howto.when_en: When you want to run hyperframes add/catalog, install a specific block/component or all blocks with a tag, or wire an installed item into index.html — any registry operation.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block for me.
say_en.note: It will be placed under compositions/ and show wiring info.

say_en.text: Search for a block that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Runs catalog --query and ranks matches by relevance.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into my current project.
say_en.note: Guides copying its HTML, CSS, and JS snippets.
